mapper.sql:
FROM diag_result_gross_sku g
INNER JOIN diag_result_price_band_sku pb ON pb.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND pb.query_hash = g.query_hash AND pb.data_version = g.data_version AND pb.product_no = g.product_no
INNER JOIN product_tag_info pti ON pti.product_no = g.product_no AND pti.tag_type_no = #{tagType}
LEFT JOIN diag_result_abc_sku abc ON abc.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND abc.query_hash = g.query_hash AND abc.data_version = g.data_version AND abc.product_no = g.product_no AND abc.abc_type = #{abcType} LEFT JOIN diag_result_abc_sku gross_abc ON gross_abc.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND gross_abc.query_hash = g.query_hash AND gross_abc.data_version = g.data_version AND gross_abc.product_no = g.product_no AND gross_abc.abc_type = 'gross' LEFT JOIN diag_result_abc_sku contribution_abc ON contribution_abc.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND contribution_abc.query_hash = g.query_hash AND contribution_abc.data_version = g.data_version AND contribution_abc.product_no = g.product_no AND contribution_abc.abc_type = 'contribution'
mapper.select:
SELECT g.product_no AS productNo, g.product_name AS productName, g.product_status AS productStatus, g.product_status_no AS productStatusNo, g.store_num AS storeNum, abc.current_abc AS currentSalesAbc, abc.compare_abc AS compareSalesAbc, gross_abc.current_abc AS currentGrossAbc, gross_abc.compare_abc AS compareGrossAbc, contribution_abc.current_abc AS currentContributionAbc, contribution_abc.compare_abc AS compareContributionAbc, g.current_gross_role AS currentGrossRole, g.compare_gross_role AS compareGrossRole, g.current_gmroi_role AS currentGmroiRole, g.compare_gmroi_role AS compareGmroiRole, g.sale_quantity AS saleQuantity, g.sale_quantity_psd AS saleQuantityPsd, g.sales, g.sales_per AS salesPer, g.sales_psd AS salesPsd, g.gross, g.gross_per AS grossPer, g.gross_psd AS grossPsd, g.gross_rate AS grossRate, g.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, g.turnover_rate AS turnoverRate, g.turnover_days AS turnoverDays, g.stock_sales_rate AS stockSalesRate, g.contribution_rate AS contributionRate, g.gmroi, g.sales_rate AS salesRate, g.activity, g.first_sale_date AS firstSaleDate, g.new_product AS newProduct, g.key_product AS keyProduct, g.seasonable_flag AS seasonableFlag, g.seasonable_flag_name AS seasonableFlagName, g.seasonable_start_date AS seasonableStartDate, g.seasonable_end_date AS seasonableEndDate, g.class_no AS classNo, g.class_name AS className, g.class_level AS classLevel, g.product_barcode AS productBarcode, g.brand_name AS brandName, g.spec, g.in_price AS inPrice, g.sales_price AS salesPrice, g.product_vendor_no AS productVendorNo, g.product_vendor_name AS productVendorName, g.product_vendor_no_name AS productVendorNoName
ORDER BY ${orderBy} ${orderType}, g.product_no ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
